items.q: we left Piobino in the car of the trumpet player whose name is Fausto Rossi.

ctx.x: On the same bill,was a big Swiss orchestra with whom I had worked two years before, "The friends of Jazz", from Cortaillod,under the leadership of Henri Du Paquier, sax-tenor, with Etienne Perret,trumpet, I was surprised and delighted to hear how much they had improved, and they had a big success.(Cortaillod is a small town near Neuchatel).

The "Genoa dixieland All Stars" did not loose any time in arranging some concerts in their part of Italy. Lily and I flew to Genoa the 17th of October and the first concert was that night in a town called Novi Ligure, a few miles from Genoa. The second concert was at the club the orchestra owns in Genoa. It was quite a large place and I was told after the concert that there had never been so many people in that club as there were that night. December the third and fourth, I recorded with my long time friend, Stephane Grappelli, the great jazz violinist. Stephane and I have played together on many occasions since my return to Europe but this was the first time we have recorded an album together since the 1935 to 1938 era. We've played attractions in clubs, for galas, done television shows, but making records for the first time since before the last world war, was something I had been looking forward to for a long time.
